summary: Master envelope for the full-fleet self-improving AI loop. 13 domain chats × 8-layer AI stack (ledger/RAG/NN/HGT/transformer-FT/S-LoRA/CoV-reasoning/custom-algos) = 104 units. India coordinates; domain chats own implementation. Substrate (PSN-SELF-IMPROVING-LOOP-MS0) already shipped 2026-05-25 — every domain chat composes the shared substrate, never re-derives it. Revolving loop cadence: hourly outcomes → india aggregates → /system-viz roost → retrain → envelope updates → repeat. Goal-gate-driving target: every PRISM domain has measurable per-shop learning end-to-end with JM Die as canonical baseline.
